name: MathDoku
description: Fill a grid with digits in an arithmetic and logic puzzle that is similar to Sudoku.

fields.name: Play Music in Cages
fields.description: Each number group will have a background tune. Useful for getting an intuitive sense of which number cage you are in.

fields.name: Announce Empty Spaces
fields.description: A bit clearer, but a seasoned player might find it repetitive
